title: Synthesis and application of POLYseq for profiling human liver organoids
protocol: Let reagents warm to 20°C–25°C if stored at −20°C.
Vortex dissolved reagents to ensure proper mixing following thawing.
Calculate the required mass of each component using equation 1.
Mix acrylate and alkanolamine monomers at a determined molar ratio for creating an acrylate backbone.
Add all backbone components (acrylate monomers and alkanolamine) into glass vial with suitable airtight cap.
Mix the monomers either by pipetting or through vortex mixing for 30 s to achieve homogeneity.
Heat the mixture in an oil or sand bath affixed to a temperature controllable hotplate at 90°C for 20 h.
Adjust the hotplate to 50°C, remove backbone from hot bath.
Allow the backbone to cool to 25°C and add respective amount of desired capping agent dropwise while vortex mixing.
Heat the mixture at 50°C for 24 h after addition of capping agent.
Dissolve capped POLYseq in 25 mM HEPES, pH = 7.4 at a final concentration of 10 mg/mL to achieve the working solution (50 μL DMSO stock in 950 μL HEPES buffer).
Optionally, add 1 μL of DyLight NHS stock solution to each 100 μL of 10 mg/mL POLYseq working solution for conjugation.
Vortex unconjugated POLYseq during addition of DyLight NHS Ester.
Maintain POLYseq at 20°C–25°C in the dark for 30 min following DyLight NHS Ester addition to complete conjugation.
Aliquot as desired and freeze unused POLYseq at −20°C.
Create a 2.5 % agarose gel by dissolving 2.5 grams of agarose, low electroendoosmotic (EEO) in 100 mL of TAE buffer (0.5× concentration).
Add 10 μL of 10,00× SYBR Safe stock solution to the agarose before casting.
Cast the gel using a BioRad gel station with a 20-well comb setup or an alternate casting station.
Dilute 10 mg/mL POLYseq solutions to 2 mg/mL with 25 mM HEPES.
Create a 1 mg/mL (1 μg/μL) solution of ssDNA barcode in 25 mM HEPES.
Wait 10 min following mixing and add 2.3 μL of loading dye without SDS.
Create a control solution of free DyLight by pipetting 1 μL of stock DyLight solution into 500 μL of HEPES buffer.
Load mixtures into cast agarose gel and run at 100 V for 30 min.
Image ssDNA barcode migration using a ChemiDoc MP or similar gel station capable of imaging SYBR safe.
If imaging DyLight conjugated POLYseq, image gel with ChemiDoc MP with pre-set fluorescent mode or similar gel station with fluorescent imaging.
Re-freeze POLYseq working solution and ssDNA aliquots at -20°C.
Avoid the use of Sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) in loading dye during gel electrophoresis.
Use Gel Loading Dye, Purple (6×), no SDS for compatibility with POLYseq.
Store diluted POLYseq in HEPES at -20°C without detriment for at least six months.
Culture Hep G2 cells in Minimal Essential Medium (MEM) supplemented with 10 % FBS in tissue culture treated 6-well or 10 cm dishes at 37°C under 5 % CO2.
Split the cultures when confluency reaches 70–80%.
If recovering cells from a frozen stock, allow for at least one passage prior to barcoding to allow for recovery.
Add 1 μg ssDNA barcode to 25 μL Opti-MEM in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 10 μg POLY2 to 25 μL Opti-MEM in a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Mix (a) into (b) with pipette mixing and allow 10 min for complexation.
Remove medium from Hep G2 cultures.
Add 1 mL Accutase into each well of a 6-well plate or 3 mL Accutase into one 10 cm dish.
Warm the Accutase in 37°C cell culture incubator for 5 min.
Gently pipette Accutase solution to dislodge cells from the culture dish.
Add 1 mL of dissociated cells to 9 mL of MEM + 10 % FBS to quench Accutase.
Spin cells at 280×g for 3 min to pellet.
Carefully aspirate supernatant using a vacuum flask or pipette and resuspend cells in 2 mL Opti-MEM for cells harvested from 6-well plates or 5 mL for cells harvested from 10 cm dishes.
Count number of live cells/mL on Countess II automated cell counter.
Aliquot 1E6 (1×10^6) number of live cells.
Spin aliquoted cells at 400×g for 3 min to pellet.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum flask or pipette.
Resuspend cell pellet in 1 mL Opti-MEM.
Aliquot 10 μL of POLYseq barcoding vector into a new microcentrifuge tube.
Remove a 100 μL aliquot (100k cells) and add to the 10 μL aliquot of prepared POLYseq barcoding vector.
Incubate with Hep G2 at 37°C for 5 min.
Dilute cells with 1 mL of ice-cold PBS + 0.2 % FBS.
Spin cells at 400×g for 3 min.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum flask or pipette.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL ice-cold PBS + 0.2 % FBS.
Gently pipette to resuspend pellet.
Spin cells at 400×g for 3 min.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum flask or pipette.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL ice-cold PBS + 0.2 % FBS.
Gently pipette to resuspend pellet.
Spin cells at 400×g for 3 min.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum flask or pipette.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL ice-cold PBS + 0.2 % FBS.
Gently pipette to resuspend pellet.
Mix Hep G2 with other barcoded cells.
Count number of live cells/mL on Countess II automated cell counter.
Spin cells at 400×g for 3 min.
Aspirate supernatant using a vacuum flask or pipette.
Resuspend cells at a final concentration of 1E6 (1×106) live cells/mL.
Gently pipette to resuspend pellet.
Culture anterior and posterior gut cells in 6-well cell culture treated dishes.
Spike DyLight conjugated POLYseq directly into cell culture medium to a final concentration of 20 μg/mL.
Culture cells at 37°C, 5% CO₂ for 24 hours.
Aspirate the cell culture solution containing DyLight conjugated POLYseq.
Wash cells twice with DMEM/F-12 to remove unbound POLYseq.
Add 1 mL of Accutase into each well of a 6-well plate or 0.5 mL to each well of a 24-well plate.
Warm the Accutase solution in a 37°C cell culture incubator for 5 minutes.
Gently pipette the Accutase solution to dislodge cells from the culture dish.
Dilute dissociated cells in 4 mL of cell culture buffer to quench Accutase.
Count number of live cells/mL on Countess II automated cell counter.
Aliquot 1E6 number of live cells.
Spin cells at 280×g for 3 min to pellet.
Resuspend cells in mTeSR supplemented with Y-27632 and Laminin-511 at a final concentration of 200,000 cells per mL.
Pipette 100 μL (20,000 live cells) into each well of a 96-well ultra-low attachment U-bottom plate.
Centrifuge plates at 160×g for 2 min to pellet cells.
Allow spheroids to form for 24 h.
Pipette single anterior spheroids into wells containing single posterior spheroids.
Allow two spheroids to fuse for 24 h.
Dissociate fused spheroids at 24 h following step 17 through digestion with a mixture of 0.9× Accutase + 1.0× TrypLE Express at 37°C with gentle pipetting.
Filter samples through 40 μm mesh following dissociation to remove large debris.
Run unstained, single-stained controls, and multi-stained samples on a flow cytometer capable of detecting conjugated colors for analysis of total labeling and double labeled populations.
Counter stain live cells using Tetramethylrhodamine, methyl ester at a concentration of 1 μM for mitochondrial staining.
Stain lysosomes in live cells using LysoTracker Blue DND-22 at a concentration of 1 μM.
Add SiR-Actin to the culture medium at a concentration of 500 nM for actin staining.
Incubate stained cells with all dyes directly in the culture medium for 1 hour.
